description: 5 exemplars + 3 near-misses + 2 counterexamples. Authored 2026-11-03 when round inbox-2026-11-u added the AI-assisted screening section. Exemplars cover designing or auditing an engineering interview loop, a model in the screening step, and the German phrasing. Near-misses are neighbours that share hiring vocabulary and are another skill's job: comp bands (comp-banding), new-hire onboarding (onboarding-program), performance reviews (perf-feedback-craft). Counterexamples guard the 'loop' and 'screen' homonyms (an event loop, a screen layout) that carry none of the hiring meaning.
